privacy.subtitle: Personal data protection & GDPR compliance — Last updated: July 28, 2026
privacy.sec1_body: The person responsible for processing the personal data collected on this site is:
privacy.sec1_contact: For any question relating to the protection of your data, you can contact us by email:
privacy.sec2_body: We only collect data sent voluntarily via our contact form:
privacy.sec2_purpose: Purpose & Legal basis: Respond to your inquiries and establish commercial proposals (Legitimate interest / Pre-contractual measures - Art. 6.1 GDPR).
privacy.sec3_li1: Information requests: 3 years maximum from the last contact from you.
privacy.sec3_li2: Business relationships: For the duration of the contractual relationship, then 5 to 10 years according to legal accounting and tax obligations.
privacy.sec4_body: Your data is strictly intended for Bkn Tech team members. No resale or transfer to third parties.
privacy.sec4_sub: Our hosting and email routing infrastructures are operated by OVHcloud SAS on secure servers located exclusively in France / European Union.
privacy.sec5_body: This site does not use any advertising targeting cookies or third-party trackers for behavioral analysis purposes (e.g. Google Analytics, Facebook Pixel). We only use technical local storage strictly necessary for the operation of the interface (e.g. remembering your preferred language FR/EN via i18nextLng). In accordance with CNIL guidelines, these technical elements are exempt from prior consent.
privacy.sec6_body: In accordance with European regulations (GDPR EU 2016/679) and the French Data Protection Act, you have the following rights regarding your personal data:
privacy.sec6_card1_desc: Consult or have your personal data corrected at any time.
privacy.sec6_card2_desc: Request the permanent deletion of your personal data.
privacy.sec6_card3_desc: Restrict or oppose the processing of your data.
privacy.sec6_card4_desc: Receive your data in a structured and readable format.
privacy.sec6_footer1: To exercise any of these rights, contact us by email at:
privacy.sec6_footer2: If you feel after contacting us that your rights are not respected, you can submit a complaint to the CNIL (Commission Nationale de l'Informatique et des Libertés) on their website
